$description: Type roles for Vintage, the Triple Feature identity (ADR-0040). Families are self-hosted (ADR-0008) and listed in meta.json; sizes and spacing come from the shared Tailwind scale (ADR-0027).

body.$description: All body copy, film titles in captions, metadata and inputs

display.$description: Headlines, section titles, buttons, rank numbers and stamps

label.$description: Typewriter labels: 'Feature Nº 1', reasons, the footer. Sentence case, never long text

weight.$description: A CSS font-weight for display text. `inherit` keeps the surrounding text's (Anton has one weight)

tracking.$description: A CSS letter-spacing for display text. `inherit` keeps the surrounding text's, so a parent's tracking class still reaches it

case.$description: text-transform for headlines and buttons (`case-display`). Film titles keep their own case
